notes: «كلهم عن» converges three routes at ابن، عيينة (rule 3): one group each, the tail written once.
«- قال ابن نمير حدثنا سفيان -» names the same man as ابن عيينة under another name: a wording difference, left out.
«أبيه» is the father of ابن أبي نجيح, unnamed here: relation. Umm Salama's words end the chain.
